items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: We were with Meredith Wilson who had the Army band thing going there, but he had this band we used to go.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the movies, we was doing it all. Yes. CBS. We were with Meredith Wilson who had the Army band thing going there, but he had this band we used to go. So we were always together, Snooky and I, playing with these different bands. And in 1945, when I organized it, it only took us about six months and I was in Salt Lake City for 13 weeks with my band at this biggest nightclub there, broadcasting. So we made it real quick. We went over to Chicago, went to Dallas, St. Louis, and came back to Los Angeles.
Was that when we went to the Apollo?
